description: This Java source file contains an integration test class DeviceRegistrationJmsIT that verifies the behavior of the Device Registry component's Device Registration AMQP endpoint, using JUnit5 and Vert.x for asynchronous testing.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationJmsIT
classes.description: Integration test class extending DeviceRegistrationApiTests that tests device registration over JMS/AMQP using Vert.x.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, starting registry and establishing JMS connection.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Returns the helper object for registry interactions.

methods.name: getJmsBasedClient
methods.description: Creates a JMS-based registration client for a specified tenant.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a general RegistrationClient (via JMS) for a specified tenant.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up test objects after each test run.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the test environment and disconnects JMS connection.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Test that asserting registration without device ID fails with HTTP 400.

methods.name: testRequestFailsForMissingSubject
methods.description: Test that a request lacking a subject fails with HTTP 400.

methods.name: testRequestFailsForUnsupportedOperation
methods.description: Test that an unsupported operation request fails with HTTP 400.
